---
title: "Analyzing US Births and Basketball Recruits"
format: html
author: "Andrew Lucas"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| label: data-structure

births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")

births_structure <- tibble(
  column = names(births),
  type = map_chr(births, ~ class(.x)[1]),
  example_values = map_chr(births, ~ paste(head(.x, 3), collapse = ", "))
)

births_structure
```

```{r}
#| label: summary-statistics

summary(births |> select(births, year))
```

```{r}
#| label: births-tibble-structure
#| cache: true

births_tibble <- births |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: average-births-by-calendar-position

births_by_calendar_position <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(
    average_births = mean(births),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

births_by_calendar_position
```

```{r}
#| label: births-calendar-heatmap

births_by_calendar_position |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(
      month,
      levels = 12:1,
      labels = month.name[12:1],
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = average_births)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 31, by = 2)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Mean births") +
  labs(
    x = "Day of month",
    y = "Month"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: christmas-births-comparison

christmas_data <- births_tibble |>
  filter(
    month == 12,
    date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 25, 27:30)
  ) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    baseline_births = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    pct_of_baseline = christmas_births / baseline_births * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: christmas-data-summary

summary(christmas_data)
```

```{r}
#| label: christmas-pct-by-year

ggplot(christmas_data, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Christmas births as percent of baseline"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: births-model

births_model <- lm(
  births ~ year + month + day_of_week,
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
#| label: births-adjusted

births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(
    pct_resid = resid(births_model) / mean(births) * 100
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: births-adjusted-structure

str(births_adjusted)
```

```{r}
#| label: calendar-resid

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(calendar_date = make_date(2001, month, date_of_month)) |>
  arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
#| label: calendar-resid-line-chart

holiday_labels <- tibble(
  calendar_date = as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2001-12-24", "2001-12-25")),
  holiday = c("New Year's Day", "Christmas Eve", "Christmas")
) |>
  left_join(calendar_resid, by = "calendar_date")

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(label = holiday),
    nudge_y = 3,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Fewer Babies Are Born on Holidays",
    subtitle = "US births relative to year-, month-, and weekday-adjusted basline (1994-2014)",
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean residual (%)"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: nba-recruits-structure

nba_recruits <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx")

nba_recruits_structure <- tibble(
  column = names(nba_recruits),
  type = map_chr(nba_recruits, ~ class(.x)[1]),
  example_values = map_chr(
    nba_recruits,
    ~ paste(head(.x, 3), collapse = ", ")
  )
)

nba_recruits_structure
```

```{r}
#| label: basketball-tibble
#| cache: true

basketball_tibble <- nba_recruits |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c(
        "Never played",
        "Brief career",
        "Solid career",
        "All-Star level",
        "Superstar"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c(
        "#1–10",
        "#11–25",
        "#26–50",
        "#51–100",
        "Outside top 100"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: career-tier-by-recruit-group

basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa)) -> basketball_plot_data

notable_players <- basketball_plot_data |>
  slice_max(top_mean_wa, n = 4, with_ties = FALSE)

ggplot(basketball_plot_data, aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, color = tier)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = notable_players,
    aes(label = name),
    nudge_y = 1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Recruit rank",
    y = "Peak Wins Added",
    color = "Career tier"
  )
```
